definitions.explanation: In everyday Japanese usage since 2020, refers to COVID-19 and the social impact of the pandemic. Used as a casual shorthand where English would more often say 'COVID'. The formal name is {新型|しんがた}コロナウイルス.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}で{生活|せいかつ}が{変|か}わった。
examples.english: Life changed during the COVID pandemic.

examples.japanese: コロナの{影響|えいきょう}で{在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}が{広|ひろ}まった。
examples.english: Working from home spread widely due to the impact of COVID.

notes:
Originally short for コロナウイルス (coronavirus), but since the COVID-19 pandemic the word is almost always understood to mean COVID-19 specifically. The full formal name is {新型|しんがた}コロナウイルス{感染症|かんせんしょう} (COVID-19).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コロナにかかる: to catch COVID
- コロナ{禍|か}: the COVID pandemic / its impact (literary; very common in news)
- コロナ{対策|たいさく}: COVID countermeasures
- ポストコロナ / アフターコロナ: post-COVID
- コロナワクチン: COVID vaccine

NOTE ON USAGE:
コロナ may also appear as a brand name (e.g., the Mexican beer or the Toyota Corona car), but in conversation since 2020 it overwhelmingly refers to COVID-19.
